$1024 IN PRIZES FOR VIDEOS ON THE COMMUNISTIC SOCIETIES OF THE UNITED STATES

Book club pick #2: Charles Nordhoff's 1875 survey of American communes. Make a vertical 9:16 video, 59 seconds or less, for a viewer with no context: what the communities had in common, why some lasted a century while others collapsed within years, and what new communities can learn.

$512 for first and up to four $128 runners-up. AI tools are allowed; AI slop is not. Submissions close in three days.

$1024 IN PRIZES FOR VIDEOS ON TIEBOUT SORTING

Book club pick #1: Charles Tiebout's 1956 paper "A Pure Theory of Local Expenditures." Make a vertical 9:16 video, 59 seconds or less, that explains Tiebout sorting concretely to a viewer starting cold.

$512 for first and up to four $128 runners-up. AI tools allowed; AI slop is not. Three days.
Farcaster is now an interactive book club. Every few days we pick a text and pay for the best short video explaining it.

Thank you to everyone who submitted videos on Norbert Elias and civility.

1st place ($1,024): farcaster.xyz/papa/0x780d71e5
2nd place ($512): farcaster.xyz/zatweirdaj/0xe8115efc
